name: Puerta de Hierro

position.source: https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/568626354 (centroid of the outline; long axis at 67.7°)

rights.note: Sculpture by Juan Domingo Olivieri (died 1762), ironwork by Francisco Barranco. Moved stone by stone in 1991 to a traffic island near its first place.

notes: Built by code (model_sources/Q962107_puerta_de_hierro.py, tools/meshkit.py) with AI assistance. Both façades alike: arch with fluted Tuscan pilasters, trophy reliefs, scroll buttresses, triangular pediment, two reclining sphinxes and the royal arms of Fernando VI between flags (top 14.7 m); two loose end piers with flaming vases and wrought-iron railings and gate. Sculpture is stylised.
